name: Drutopia Landing Page (DEPRECATED)
description: DEPRECATED config-only Features module of the Drutopia distribution that installs a Landing Page node type with a paragraph body, meta tags, Display Suite view displays, a pathauto pattern, an exclude-node-title setting, and editor/manager role permission grants; maintainers recommend the Page feature instead.
project_description: Drutopia Landing Page is a base feature (Features bundle 'drutopia') of the Drutopia distribution, now marked DEPRECATED in its own name and description — the maintainers recommend using the generic Page feature instead. It is a config-only module: it ships no PHP, routes, services, hooks, or permissions of its own. Installing it imports a 'landing_page' node type, a paragraph body field (field_body_paragraph, entity_reference_revisions to text/file/image/slide paragraph types), a meta tags field, form and view displays (default, a Display Suite ds_1col 'full' display, and a disabled teaser), a pathauto URL pattern, a promote base-field override, an exclude_node_title configuration action, and config actions that grant landing-page permissions to the Drutopia editor and manager roles. Installed here as a dev checkout (info.yml has no version line); the version directory tracks the 2.0.x dev branch. It carries the Drutopia dependency chain (drutopia_core, drutopia_seo) plus ds, entity_reference_revisions, exclude_node_title, metatag, paragraphs and pathauto, and is normally installed through the distribution rather than standalone.
